answer: Seed a few submissions that are junk by construction, machine-verifiably empty, chaff dressed to look like merit. An honest grader scores them low at dawn; any grader that passes one marks itself against a known-bad ground truth and is slashed. The gap between the verdict and the planted answer needs no human judgment, black and unmistakable as onyx. A hollow grader that rubber-stamps everything trips the bait at once, so collusion and lazy auto-approval both surface cheaply and exactly.
